text:
Situation: Isoflurane is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 12 days of supply, Corvale General holds 17 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 20 days at current burn rates. The NDC in use lists Piramal Critical Care as the manufacturer.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list does not include isoflurane today, and no public signal has been issued for the plants supplying our facilities.

Our position: Supply is limited but not in shortage per FDA. We must secure additional stock before any site falls below a safe threshold.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. per the established rule; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC as a secondary source; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Piramal Critical Care Inc as a tertiary source; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. as a quaternary source; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
